description: Ask for a new STIR/SHAKEN signing key: it is generated inside Kazoo and the answer is its metadata and a certificate signing request, never the private key

organization.description: The organization (O) the certificate signing request names: the legal name of the service provider the certificate is for. Defaults to csr_organization in system_config/stir; a key cannot be created when neither is set

scope.description: Whose calls the key signs: the platform's ('system') or one reseller account's (its account id). Under /v2/accounts/{id}/stir/keys it may only be that account

spc.description: The Service Provider Code the certificate will be issued for, e.g. 999Y
